svg.title: Hand pallet truck — Handbrettatjakkur
svg.desc: A tall loop handle steers a compact hydraulic base with two long low pallet forks shown in perspective.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-pallet-truck","label_en":"Hand pallet truck","label_is":"Handbrettatjakkur","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["site-logistics","pallet-handling"],"description":"A tall loop handle steers a compact hydraulic base with two long low pallet forks shown in perspective.","design_note":"Low paired forks and a hand tiller identify a pallet truck without adding a lifting mast.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
